summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting to signed-in account  ### What I found before writing this plan I read the full chain end to end (read-only, no edits): `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx`, `client/src/lib/api.ts`, `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`, `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, `db/auth.ts`, and `server.ts`.  Notably, **the code as it exists today looks correctly wired**: - `api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every request, so the `arca_session` cookie should always be attached. - `WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localStorage/sessionStorage
